author: claude
summary: Audit for pre-built-but-unwired/undocumented code (owner-requested sweep) surfaced that run.sh/run.ps1 invoke a Python module path that no longer exists -- app.domain.demo_bundle was moved into app/domain/ at some point without updating the two launchers, which still shell out to app.demo_bundle. This silently broke automatic demo-library installation on every real launch: the ModuleNotFoundError from the wrong path was swallowed by the launcher's own status-check guard, which treats any non-zero exit as 'no restore needed' and skips the install.

files.change: maybe_restore_demo_bundle(): both `python -m app.demo_bundle status ...` and `... restore ...` invocations corrected to `python -m app.domain.demo_bundle`.
Same fix in the PowerShell demo-restore block: both status and restore invocations corrected to app.domain.demo_bundle.

New parametrized test test_launcher_invokes_the_module_at_its_real_import_path (run.sh, run.ps1) -- greps each launcher's source text for the real module path and asserts the stale app.demo_bundle string is absent, so this specific drift can't silently recur.

revert_checked: git stash of run.sh + run.ps1: both new parametrized cases failed (module path string absent/stale), 3 pre-existing tests in the file still passed; git stash pop restored the fix, all 5 tests green.
verified_live: Ran `./venv/bin/python -m app.domain.demo_bundle status --base-dir <tmp>` directly -- exits 0 with 'restore-needed' (previously `python -m app.demo_bundle` raised ModuleNotFoundError, exit 1).
known_gap_flagged_not_fixed: Same audit found app/engines/video_utils.py (generate_video_sample, real ffmpeg-based MP4 voice-preview renderer, commit bb2bb025) as pre-built but never wired to any route/task/plugin -- flagged in TASKS.md's new 'Pre-built, not yet wired' section for an owner call on whether to build the missing UI/route, not fixed here.
